user.title: Solar Shade
user.description: Solar Shade will download LiDAR elevation data for your property and create shadow sensors. All settings can be configured from the Solar Shade panel after setup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Solar Shade is allowed.

select_laz.title: Select LAZ File
select_laz.description: Pick a LAS/LAZ file from config/solar_shade/. Place your LiDAR download in that folder first.

data.enable_open_meteo: Enable Open-Meteo radiation sensors (built-in, no hardware needed)
data.min_cell_size: Minimum cell size (higher = faster, lower = more detail)
data.download_radius: LiDAR download radius (increase for larger properties)
data.min_shadow_height: Min shadow height (objects shorter than this don't cast shadows)
data.dsm_gap_fill: Fill DSM gaps (experimental, may cause artifacts)
data.latitude_override: Latitude override (leave blank to use HA location)
data.longitude_override: Longitude override (leave blank to use HA location)

error.invalid_coordinates: Invalid coordinate value. Latitude must be -90 to 90, longitude -180 to 180.

abort.no_laz_files: No LAS/LAZ files found in config/solar_shade/. Place your LiDAR download there first.

reload_site.name: Reload site model
reload_site.description: Reload LiDAR data and recalculate shadow zones.
